name: emc-helpline-backend-tooling
description: Emulators and tests for the EMC Helpline backend. The app itself is Flutter — see README.md.

scripts.backend: npm --prefix functions run build && node functions/scripts/backend.mjs
scripts.test:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "node functions/scripts/seed-agent.mjs && vitest run"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:emulator
scripts.console: npm run console:config && npm run console:agent
